items.title: 职业型副学士
items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE portrait Chinese mobile game study-progress screen for existing 财富人生 Wealth Life. Input image is STYLE AND LAYOUT reference, not a screen whose old numbers/rules should survive. Keep its warm hand-painted storybook cream paper, dark forest-green Chinese type, gold rounded main button, leafy accents, cozy study desk illustration upper 25%. Do not redesign visual language. Readable polished compact layout, no large empty bottom. New variant title "职业型副学士". Top back "返回房屋", header "学习进度". Main panel exact text "正在就读 · 职业型副学士", subtitle "专业待确认", badge "轻松学习". No invented profession, tuition or duration. Progress panel text "专业与学制待确认", no numeric progress denominator. Section "本月学习安排": "学习预留 40 小时" and "剩余自由时间 60 小时". Section "学费缴纳": "课程费用待确认", "本月学费待确认", disabled gray button "学费待确认". Small text "含学杂费及必需书籍费". Notice "本月学费付清后，才可进入城镇". Outline button "更改学习安排", helper "40 / 60 小时可切换，下月生效". Notice "开始学习后不可暂停或退出". Gold primary bottom "返回房屋". Tiny footer "设计预览 · 示例数据". Absolutely REMOVE "暂停学习", "退出学习" buttons, old paid-up6200 status, old48-month duration and old schedule subtitles. No new rewards, jobs, tuition interest or auto loan. This is a design preview, not app screenshot. Do not include phone device chrome. Single image not collage.
